summary: The 'ErrorOccurred' page is an ASP.NET web page designed to display error messages to users. It handles localization and customizes error messages based on request parameters and configurations set in the web.config file.
purpose: To provide users with informative error messages and assist in troubleshooting by directing errors to a configured email address.

fields.name: ErrorEmail
fields.description: Email address used in error messages, retrieved from web.config based on locale.

fields.name: Locale
fields.description: Locale parameter from the query string that determines language and culture settings.

fields.name: subject
fields.description: Subject retrieved from the configuration for personalized error messages.

fields.name: HttpRequestValidationException
fields.description: Query string parameter to determine if the specific validation exception message is shown.

workflows.name: Page Load and Error Display
steps: Detect the locale from the query string and set culture accordingly.
Determine the visibility of HeaderEN or HeaderFR based on the locale.
Retrieve the ErrorEmail from configuration based on locale.
Check if HttpRequestValidationException is set in the query string.
Set the error message text based on the exception type using resources.

business_rules: If Locale is 'en-US' or empty, use the default English locale settings.
The email address in the error message is configurable via web.config.
Different email addresses can be set for English and alternative locales.
validations: Check if the locale parameter is valid before setting culture.
Ensure HttpRequestValidationException is a recognized query string value.

conditions.action: Display English header and use ERROR_EMAIL
Display French header and use ERROR_EMAIL_ALT

system_behavior: The page initializes culture settings based on the specified or default locale.
The page uses ASP.NET web form controls to display headers and error messages.
dependencies: ASP.NET Framework for page lifecycle and controls
exceptions: HttpRequestValidationException handling if specified in query string
